questions.q: Estimate the mean: 0 < t ≤ 10 has frequency 4, 10 < t ≤ 20 has frequency 6.
A histogram bar has class width 5 and frequency density 3.2. Find the frequency.
A cumulative frequency graph shows 80 values. At what cumulative frequency do you read the lower quartile?
questions.why: For a cumulative frequency graph use n/4 = 80 ÷ 4 = 20.

questions.model: The middle two values are 7 and 9, so median = (7 + 9) ÷ 2 = 8
